intent.references: narrow lyrical motif, inner-voice chromaticism, unresolved close

narrative.description: initial affect established by multiple parameters
solo felt piano states a narrow motif
inner voice moves under the repeated motif
cello answers without doubling the melody
borrowed colour briefly warms the room
texture thins after the peak; the motif is exposed

sections.name: Prelude
sections.description: solo piano states a narrow cell; no percussion, no full pad

sections.name: First Memory
sections.description: the cell repeats over a moving inner voice

sections.name: Inner Motion
sections.description: same contour, different bass and inversion; viola enters

sections.name: Distant Warmth
sections.description: borrowed colour opens briefly; no full climax

sections.name: Return
sections.description: the opening cell returns with a changed ending

sections.name: Coda
sections.description: texture withdraws; the last ninth is left unresolved

motifs.name: Three-note turn
motifs.description: Scale degrees 0-2-1-4 with a long final tone; narrow, speech-like, no heroic leap.
